'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|"Greetings, soldier! Got a rather specific job for you. I need a close-quarters weapon put through a proper field test. True combat conditions only. I reckon you know exactly where to find those, eh?Some of my customers aren't convinced this little beauty can get the job done... Think you can persuade them?Oh, one more thing: if you lose the gun, you can get a new one from Mechanic.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 5 PMC operatives with an [[MP5|MP5SD]] on [[Woods]], [[Ground Zero]], [[Interchange]] or [[Customs]]

==Rewards==
* +3,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.1'''</font>
* 80,000 Roubles
** 84,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 92,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Electric motor]]
* Unlocks Duck [[Hideout]] shooting range target style
{{quote|Well done, mission accomplished. Looks like every last customer has been persuaded.}}
